description: This source file defines an interface for creating and interacting with grain services, as well as an internal class implementing this interface for internal use within Orleans runtime. The class primarily provides functionality to cast grain references to typed grain service references.

classes.name: GrainServiceFactory
classes.description: An internal implementation of IGrainServiceFactory that uses IRuntimeClient to cast grain references to grain services.

methods.name: CastToGrainServiceReference
methods.description: Casts a grain reference to a specified grain service type using the runtime client's internal grain factory.
